**Unit 5 incident lesson (reversal handoff):**
The chunks dir was redirected via env var before running `engram update`; the command resolved its own path rather than honoring the redirect, so the live index was modified and a sentinel file written to it — exactly what the isolation was meant to prevent. Lesson: before any destructive command targeting an env-var-redirected path, confirm the redirect is actually honored (e.g. `engram config show` or equivalent) before proceeding; a silent no-op redirect leaves the live system as the target. This is the one unmapped lesson from this cycle.
